edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims and disputes between them arising out of or relating to this action. As used in this Agreement, “Effective Date” means the date on which the last signatory executes this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount of USD 31,500,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within five (5) business days after the Effective Date, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff’s counsel.

2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, for itself and its successors, assigns, agents, and affiliates, releases and forever discharges Defendant and its current and former parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, and successors from any and all claims, demands, liabilities, damages, and causes of action, known or unknown, asserted or unasserted, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this action.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential, except as required by law, regulation, court order, or for disclosure to the parties’ counsel, accountants, insurers, tax advisors, and immediate family members who are informed of and agree to maintain confidentiality; provided, however, that each party may disclose the terms of this Agreement as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement or to obtain tax, accounting, insurance, or legal advice, and in connection with any governmental or judicial inquiry.

4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party, and neither this Agreement nor the settlement is admissible except to enforce its terms or as otherwise required by law.

5. DISMISSAL. Within five (5) business days after Plaintiff’s counsel confirms receipt of cleared funds in the full amount of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff shall file a stipulation of dismissal with prejudice, with each party to bear its own attorneys’ fees and costs unless otherwise agreed in writing.

6. ENFORCEMENT; TAXES. The Court shall retain jurisdiction, to the extent permitted by law, to enforce the terms of this Agreement. Each party shall be responsible for its own tax obligations arising from or relating to this Agreement, and no party makes any representation regarding the tax treatment of any payment hereunder.
